hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *CLAUDE.md) echo '[hook] WARNING: every CLAUDE.md is a one-line @AGENTS.md shim. Put the content in the matching AGENTS.md instead (see adr/0001-agent-docs-structure.md).' ;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *manifest.json) echo '[hook] manifest.json changed. A new permission or any page access must follow adr/0002-dialog-in-a-popup-window.md. Load the extension unpacked once: the type check cannot see a broken manifest.' ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *.js|*.json|*.md|*.css|*.html|*.yml) npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *src/notes/*|*src/pageAddress/*) echo '[hook] Note logic changed. Run the validate agent before you open a PR.' ;; esac
